description:
Bodyweight squats are a simple way to strengthen your legs and support your knees as part of a regular exercise routine.

This compound exercise works your quads, glutes, and lower body, helping to improve strength, stability and movement. Squats can also support knee health, reduce injury risk and help with recovery after injury when done with good form.

This video shows you how to do bodyweight squats correctly to build strength and protect your joints.

Find out more about exercises that help strengthen your knees:
https://www.bupa.co.uk/newsroom/ourviews/knee-strengthening-exercises?pdg_channel=vid&pdg_network=youtube&pdg_campaign=healthinfo_bodysquat

Learn about physiotherapy assessment and treatment:
https://www.bupa.co.uk/bookingtool?q=physio&pdg_channel=vid&pdg_network=youtube&pdg_campaign=healthproduct_bodysquat
